status: What the ontology lacks to answer evals/dev/expired-disposition/proposed_items.json: one entry per gap of the Expired-Material Disposition Map (map_gap_index 1-10, in the map's order) plus the disposal, replacement and waiver-verification links its stages name. map_says is the map's claim, attributed to the QC owner's walkthrough of 16 Oct 2026; implementation, where present, is a claim about deployed Portal or BC behaviour that nobody here verified (the map's review notes: portal code not verified). Each gap names its system of record, or says 'source unknown' with the question for QC. Sources are named, never read here; OntologyProject refs are at the base c11ad1ed5732, the map's record at codex/advisory c8fcb26d00c8.

gaps.name: LotRestriction (a lot usable only for a named batch, customer or non-compendial use, from its waiver or approval) enforced at picking and posting
gaps.map_says: approved lots cannot be restricted; the R-0030 waiver names one batch yet nothing stops the lot going into another; the pick step is where the gate belongs
gaps.implementation: the map says the Portal pick step has no lot-restriction check and BC Strict Expiration Posting would be the posting control; both unverified against Portal code and PLX's BC setup
gaps.ontology_today: PickList and PickLine are Portal models outside the reporting API; Lot is a pending placeholder (not served); no restriction member or link exists.
gaps.dot_question: QC: where is a waiver's or approval's batch or customer restriction recorded today besides the signed PDF (a hand-marked label, the QC log), and who checks it when a batch is picked?

gaps.map_gap: No disposition case; requests and priorities run by email
gaps.name: DispositionCase (one per lot: trigger, routes with status, documents, single closing decision with owner and date)
gaps.map_says: no disposition case; requests and priorities run by email and the outcome is typed into four unlinked places
gaps.implementation: the map's target is a Portal case; the map says none exists, unverified
gaps.ontology_today: No case, decision or route object for a lot; Attachment is a Portal model outside the reporting API.

sources.relation: the map's advisory record (the claim, not a reader)

gaps.dot_question: QC: is there any record today that lists the open expired-lot cases and their routes (a QC spreadsheet log, a SharePoint folder of Form 063s), and where is it kept?

gaps.map_gap: Waivers approve without a new date
gaps.name: Lot.consumption_exception (a one-batch release of an expired lot that keeps its original expiry) and its BC posting path
gaps.map_says: waivers approve without a new date; Strict Expiration Posting would refuse consumption of that lot, so the exception needs a defined posting path (open design decision)
gaps.implementation: Strict Expiration Posting behaviour is the map's expectation of standard BC; unverified against PLX's item tracking codes
gaps.ontology_today: No exception, waiver or expiry-override member on Lot, ItemLedgerEntry or any BC binding.

sources.relation: the map's advisory record (the claim, not a reader)

gaps.dot_question: QC: when a waiver releases an expired lot to one batch, how is its consumption posted today (a temporary new date, a manual override, no BC posting), and who decides?

gaps.name: CustomerExpiredMaterialPolicy (allowed with QC justification / ask first / never, cited to the quality agreement)
gaps.map_says: customer acceptance is implied (A2, A6); restrictions live in people's heads
gaps.implementation: the map says app_customer has no expired-material policy field; unverified
gaps.ontology_today: Customer is served (public.app_customer) with no policy member; no quality-agreement object.
gaps.system_of_record: today: no record (the map: tribal knowledge); the quality agreement per customer is the document a policy would be cited to; target (map): a field on the Portal customer

gaps.name: LotLabel (a printed container label tied to the lot record: expiry, extension marker and count, re-release date)
gaps.map_says: the label hides the extension: R-0663's reissued label keeps the April release
gaps.implementation: the map says the Portal does not print raw-material labels from the lot record (to confirm); unverified
gaps.ontology_today: No label object or link from a label to a lot or to Form 063.

sources.relation: the map's advisory record (the claim, not a reader)

gaps.dot_question: QC: where are raw-material container labels printed from today (a template, FileMaker, the Portal), and is a copy of each reprint kept anywhere besides Form 063?

gaps.name: LotRetestResult (a retest or recertification result per lot and attribute, route type, tests run, sent out or omitted, risks covered)
gaps.map_says: justification text is free-form; results are on Form 063 under SOP QC-002 (paper or PDF), not structured per lot and attribute
gaps.ontology_today: CertificateOfAnalysis covers a supplier CoA of one lot (served from mail and SharePoint); no object holds Petra's own retest results or a justification.
gaps.dot_question: QC: where are completed Form 063 records and FT-IR printouts filed (a SharePoint library, a shared drive, paper only), and may the Workbench read that location?

gaps.name: Remaining shelf life at receipt (expiry date of a received raw-material lot against its receipt date)
gaps.map_says: short-dated receipts feed the process: R-0663 was released in April with about five and a half months left
gaps.ontology_today: ReceiptLine.expiry_date is served from the FM raw-material receipt and the gold receipt line; no remaining-shelf-life measure.
gaps.system_of_record: FileMaker raw-material receipt (public.receipt_raw_material, served) today; the Portal receipt line as its gold copy

gaps.map_gap: Date type and extension history are not captured
gaps.name: LotExtension (each extension of a lot: route, previous and new expiry, case, approver; the count the once-per-lot rule needs) and the item's date type
gaps.map_says: date type and extension history are not captured; the 30-day route's 'never expired before' cannot be checked by any system
gaps.implementation: the map's target is a custom field on BC Lot No. Information; not built per the map, unverified
gaps.ontology_today: Lot (pending) has one expiry; no extension history, count or date-type member; no BC Lot No. Information reader.
gaps.dot_question: QC: is a lot's earlier extension recorded anywhere today (the QC log, Form 063 history, the receipt comment), and is the date type on supplier documents (expiry, best-use, retest) noted anywhere?

gaps.name: Lot.allocated_to_batch (the raw-material lot a scheduled batch will consume, with the batch date) for priority by batch demand
gaps.map_says: cases open at scheduling time; a look-ahead of lots expiring before their scheduled use would give the manufacturer and procurement routes time
gaps.ontology_today: BatchSchedule and Batch are served; lot numbers appear only as text on AO, MO, batch and receipt rows, so no lot-to-batch link exists.

sources.relation: Lot availability (lot numbers as text only)

gaps.system_of_record: FileMaker batch schedule (public.batch_calibration, served) for batch dates; the lot-to-batch allocation has no system of record the Workbench reads

gaps.name: A lot's current expiry from every copy: FileMaker receipt, Portal lot and BC item ledger (lot number and expiration date)
gaps.map_says: lot dates live in FileMaker: QC release updates only the FileMaker receipt row, and a new expiry is typed into its comment field, the QC log and the label
gaps.implementation: the map says QC release writes only the FileMaker receipt row; unverified against Portal code
gaps.ontology_today: FM receipt expirydate is served; the Portal lot is not served; the BC itemLedgerEntries allowlist reads no lot number and no expiration date.
gaps.system_of_record: today (map): the FileMaker receipt row (public.receipt_raw_material, served), with the new date in a free-text comment; target (map): the BC lot

gaps.name: Disposal.write_off (the write-off of a rejected lot to its case, with a reason code and the case number; returned quantity of customer-supplied lots)
gaps.map_says: no reason code links the write-off to the case; a customer-supplied lot's return or disposal instruction is not recorded
gaps.implementation: the map says write-offs post to BC as item journal batch PLXADJ through codeunit 50116, from the system map; unverified
gaps.ontology_today: InventoryTransaction is a Portal model outside the reporting API; ItemLedgerEntry (partial) has no case or reason link.
gaps.dot_question: QC: when an expired lot is rejected, where is the write-off or return recorded today (a WMS transaction, FileMaker, a disposal form), and is the reason kept?

gaps.name: PurchaseOrder.replaces_lot (a replacement purchase to the expired lot and case it replaces)
gaps.map_says: the replacement PO is not linked to the expired lot it replaces
gaps.ontology_today: PurchaseOrder is served; no member or link names an expired lot or a disposition case.
gaps.system_of_record: the Portal purchase order (public.app_purchase_order, served); the link itself has no system of record

gaps.name: A visual read of the signed waiver page (lot, batch, signature date) and the stage 5 and stage 12 example originals
gaps.map_says: the waiver names lot 52174440 and batch BC-26267D; the map's two further examples are pending
gaps.ontology_today: The archive is read as text extraction only; the waiver's text layer and OCR disagree on both identifiers, so they stay unverified.
